player_prompt.intro:
E te Pulega {player_id} i le Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma e aofia ai {num_rounds} tasi.

Faiga o le Pili:
- Ae le i luma o le faaiuga, e te ave {total_conversation_rounds} tasi e faaleleia ai le talanoa.
- Ae mai lea, ona faia lea e lua pulega le filifiliga e galulue faatasi po o le faaleagaina.

Taavale o le Faagaioiga (maua i le tasi):
- I le galulue faatasi e lua ➜ iga {cooperate_reward}
- I le faaleagaina e lua ➜ iga {mutual_defect_reward}
- O se tasi e faaleagaina, o se tasi e galulue faatasi ➜ Faaleagaina {defect_reward}, Galulue faatasi {sucker_reward}

Pe faapefea ona taalo:
- I le taimi o le talanoa: tusi so o se upu e te manaomia.
- I le taimi o le faaiuga: aumai '[Cooperate]' po'o '[Defect]' (e le faaliliu). E mafai ona e faaaogaina ni upu faapena mai i luma po o mulimuli o le token.

phases.conversation_finished: Malilie le talanoa mo le tasi {round}. Faamolemole tali ma '[Cooperate]' po'o '[Defect]' i totonu o  oxed{{}}.

outcome.draw: Na maua uma e le au taaalo sikoa {s0}.
outcome.round_both_cooperate: Na galulue faatasi tagata taaalo uma e toʻalua.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Na galulue faatasi le tagata taalo 0, ae na sola ese mai le tagata taaalo 1.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Na sosola le tagata taalo 0, ae na galulue faatasi le tagata taaalo 1.
